contentText: PRESS REVIEW – Wednesday, February 18, 2026: The killing of far-right activist Quentin Deranque has plunged France into political chaos, as one of the suspects was revealed to be working for the far-left France Unbowed party. Meanwhile, as tributes for civil rights activist Jesse Jackson continue to fill the papers, so too do analysis pieces about his contribution to US politics. Finally, in football, the Champions League is rocked by a racist incident during a playoff match.
